modules.alt: Mysterious basketball players in wheeled vehicles are seen in a futuristic stadium.

modules.heading: A futuristic player sits in a wheeled vehicle balancing a basketball on one finger.
Two hands are using Joy-Con 2 controllers like a mouse.

content.value: Hold each Joy-Con™ 2 controller like a mouse for tight control of both your wheels as you speed around the court.
Raise your hand and flick your wrist to shoot...and score!
Team up with—or take on—friends and other players from near and far online* in fast-paced 3-on-3 matches.

modules.alt: A hand is holding a Joy-Con 2 controller as an in-game character shoots a basketball.

modules.heading: A video shows a player dunking the basketball in the game.
The next generation of 3-on-3 sports is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 system!

content.value: Slide both controllers forward to move in that direction.

modules.heading: One hand slides forward to make the character turn.

content.value: Only slide one controller to pivot.

modules.alt: A player in a wheeled vehicle makes a sharp turn.

content.value: Raise one hand and gently flick your wrist forward to shoot.

modules.alt: A player lines up to shoot the basketball.

modules.heading: The player flicks the Joy-Con 2 controller forward like shooting a basketball and the in-game character shoots the ball and scores.

content.value: Use the half-pipe to fly into the air and perform tricks and dunks.

modules.alt: A player makes a wild dunk.

modules.heading: The player makes the in-game character dunk the basketball.

content.value: Which player type will you choose?  The speedy “Guard", with explosive driving and quick turning skills? The all-around solid "Forward", which has a more diverse skill set?  Or maybe the mighty "Center'', who has great height and physical strength. Pick the one that sounds the most fun to you and hit the court!

modules.heading: Meet up in the “Park”—a place to play online!*

content.value: "Park" is where players from around the world gather and play with a wide variety of rules, such as 3-on-3 (with up to twelve total players), racing, or shooting contests. You can also practice using the facilities in the park.
Customize your driver's appearance to your liking, including colors and texture of the vehicle, jersey number, and helmet.
By meeting certain conditions in the game, you’ll unlock more options for your helmet!
A park where players of comparable skill levels gather from all over the world. Once a certain number of players gather, they are randomly split into teams and the match starts automatically.
You can create a park as a host or join a friend's park and play with them. The host can freely set the match timing and divide the players into teams.
Even without online access, up to 8 friends can play together by bringing their Nintendo Switch 2 systems locally.
This is great for not only casual pick-up games but also to go over coordinated plays.
Software update is required.
Additional games, systems and/or accessories may be required for multiplayer mode.

asset.alt: Players talking online during a match.

modules.heading: If you use GameChat** while playing with a friend, you can talk to each other during the match.
Play with friends and players from all over the world

asset.alt: Image of the player choosing difficulty level in the offline mode.

content.value: Offline, you can play alone against a CPU, or take on time trials and shooting contests.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100099951\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Get ready to shoot hoops in a whole new way— this is the latest in 3-on-3 sports! Hold each Joy-Con™ 2 controller on a surface, like a mouse, and use them to move your wheels and speed across the court. Slide both controllers forward to move ahead, or just one controller to turn or pivot. Once you grab the ball and drive up the lane, shooting is as simple as raising your hand and flicking your wrist. Rack up even more points by using the half-pipe to launch yourself into the air for tricks and dunks!

Choose between three different drivers, each with their own stats, to play your preferred role on the court. You can also compete in additional challenges to practice your skills or compete against other players and aim for a top spot on your park’s leaderboard.

Wheel your way into 3-on-3 online action

Team up with—or take on—your friends in fast-paced 3-on-3 matches, or in minigames like Rebound Scramble and Circuit Sprint, and show your dual-mouse control skills! Challenge other players online*, get a group of friends together over GameChat**, or play alone against computer-controlled opponents to hone your moves. Pulling off those half-pipe tricks is sure to impress your friends!

Adjust your driver’s look with armor, frames, tires, and helmets

Complete challenges throughout the park to unlock customizable helmets. Match them up with your choice of armor, frame, and tires to customize your driver’s appearance to your liking.
